records.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Asset: production 2D game zombie animation sprite sheet, genuine transparent background. Reference image is the game's Nikalz fighter sprite sheet: match its hand-illustrated ink contours, painterly textured shading, realistic adult proportions, restrained colors EXACTLY. NOT 3D, NOT low polygon, NOT vector shapes, NOT cartoon/chibi. Draw Nikalz transformed into a zombie: same curly black hair, moustache/short beard, beige sweater, gray-green trousers, beige sneakers; decayed desaturated skin, sunken pale eyes, ragged sweater and trouser hems. Hunched spine, slack jaw, dangling/reaching hands. He must remain recognizable. Create exactly EIGHT distinct full-body animation frames in a strict 4-column 2-row equal-cell grid on 2048x1024 canvas. No labels, no borders, no ground shadows, no effects, no background. Every character completely contained within its cell with generous transparent separation. All face RIGHT in side/three-quarter side view like reference. Identical body proportions and pixel scale in every frame. Same floor baseline per row. Row1 left to right: 1 neutral hunched idle hands reaching; 2 dragging walk left foot forward; 3 passing step feet near together knees bent; 4 dragging walk right foot forward. Row2 left to right: 5 claw anticipation leaning back raising rear arm; 6 claw CONTACT reaching fingers sharply right shoulder-high; 7 recoiling hurt bending back; 8 collapsed corpse lying horizontally on floor, still completely inside cell. Maintain body scale even in collapsed pose. These are authored animation poses, not copies of idle. No weapons, bees, extra people, watermarks. Preserve actual alpha transparency.
